title: Gradient-coated P-doped Si3N4 with dual functions for silicon anodes: stress buffering and charge transport enhancement
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4125-4132
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00347D, Paper
Yi Zhong, Bichen Yu, Lanqing Xu, Yajing Huang, Yongping Zheng, Jiaxing Li, Zhigao Huang
A tough act to coat! We design a P-doped Si3N4 layer on Si particles that forms a robust and conductive shield. Combined with a carbon layer, the material shows high capacities in different tests. The image shows our synergy enabling the improvement.
